subject: general
question: Name the first country of the Soviet Republic (USSR) to declare its independence.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lithuania**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lithuania:**

 
 
• Officially the Republic of Lithuania is a country in the Baltic region of Europe.
 
• **It is one of three Baltic states and lies on the eastern shore of the Baltic Sea. **
